structuredContent.name: tenants.update-tenant
structuredContent.description: Replace the display name and description of an existing active tenant. Allowed for a global administrator or a tenant member with the TenantOwner or TenantContributor role. Unknown or disabled tenants are rejected.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant to update.

Name.description: New display name; replaces the current one.

Description.description: New description; replaces the current one and null clears it. To keep the current description while renaming, send it again (read it with tenants.get-tenant).
